questions.question: Yesterday, I _____ a beautiful bird.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي من see هو saw، فنقول Yesterday, I saw.

questions.question: Last night, we _____ dinner at home. (eat)
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي من eat هو ate.

questions.question: My father _____ me a new book yesterday.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي من buy هو bought.

questions.question: _____ you go to the park yesterday?
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم Did لتكوين سؤال في الماضي البسيط، ويأتي بعدها الفعل بصيغته الأساسية.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: She did not went to school.
questions.correct_answer: She did not go to school.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد did not نستخدم الفعل في صورته الأساسية go وليس went.

questions.question: When I was young, I _____ play with toy cars.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم used to للتعبير عن عادة كانت تحدث في الماضي ولم تعد تحدث الآن.

questions.question: My grandfather used to _____ a bicycle. (ride)
questions.explanation_ar: بعد used to يأتي الفعل بصيغته الأساسية ride.

questions.question: We _____ our cousins tomorrow. We have already made plans.
questions.explanation_ar: يمكن استخدام المضارع المستمر للتعبير عن ترتيب أو موعد مستقبلي تم الاتفاق عليه.

questions.question: The tortoise walks _____.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم slowly لوصف طريقة المشي، وهي حال بمعنى ببطء.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: He speaks English fluent.
questions.explanation_ar: نستخدم الحال fluently لوصف طريقة التحدث، وليس الصفة fluent.

questions.question: Match each phrasal verb with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: الأفعال المركبة تتكون من فعل وكلمة أخرى، ويختلف معناها أحيانًا عن معنى الفعل وحده.

questions.question: Please _____ the television. I want to watch the news.
questions.explanation_ar: Turn on تعني يشغّل، وهي المناسبة لتشغيل التلفاز.

questions.question: A mother must _____ her young children.
questions.explanation_ar: Look after تعني يعتني بـ.

questions.question: The noun form of happy is _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Happiness اسم بمعنى السعادة، وهو مشتق من الصفة happy.

questions.question: A person who teaches students is a _____.
questions.explanation_ar: Teacher تعني معلّم أو معلّمة، وهي اسم الشخص الذي يعلّم الطلاب.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: My little brother is very _____. He always helps people.
questions.explanation_ar: Careful صفة بمعنى حريص أو منتبه، وتصف brother.

questions.question: Match each transport word with its Arabic meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه مفردات أساسية نستخدمها عند الحديث عن السفر والمواصلات.

questions.question: Where do passengers collect their bags after a flight?
questions.explanation_ar: Baggage claim هي منطقة استلام الأمتعة في المطار.

questions.question: The sky is full of dark clouds. It may be _____.
questions.explanation_ar: الغيوم الداكنة قد تدل على احتمال هطول المطر، لذلك rainy هي الإجابة المناسبة.

questions.passage: Last Friday, Ali travelled with his family to Nizwa. They left home early in the morning by car. First, they visited the old fort. Then, they walked around the market and bought some dates. They returned home in the evening. Ali enjoyed the trip very much.
questions.question: Where did Ali travel with his family?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أن عليًا سافر مع عائلته إلى نزوى.

questions.passage: Last Friday, Ali travelled with his family to Nizwa. They left home early in the morning by car. First, they visited the old fort. Then, they walked around the market and bought some dates. They returned home in the evening. Ali enjoyed the trip very much.
questions.question: How did the family travel?
questions.explanation_ar: ورد في النص أنهم غادروا المنزل بالسيارة، by car.

questions.passage: Last Friday, Ali travelled with his family to Nizwa. They left home early in the morning by car. First, they visited the old fort. Then, they walked around the market and bought some dates. They returned home in the evening. Ali enjoyed the trip very much.
questions.question: What did they buy at the market?
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص أنهم اشتروا بعض التمور من السوق.

questions.passage: Last Friday, Ali travelled with his family to Nizwa. They left home early in the morning by car. First, they visited the old fort. Then, they walked around the market and bought some dates. They returned home in the evening. Ali enjoyed the trip very much.
questions.question: When did the family return home?
questions.explanation_ar: عادوا إلى المنزل في المساء، كما ورد في الجملة الأخيرة من أحداث الرحلة.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order: yesterday / visited / we / the museum
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب الصحيح: الفاعل We ثم الفعل الماضي visited ثم المفعول the museum ثم ظرف الزمن yesterday.

questions.question: Write three or four sentences about a trip you enjoyed. Say where you went, who went with you, what you did, and how you felt.

criteria: Mention the people who went with you.
Use past simple when describing a completed trip.
rubric.sample_answer: Last weekend, I went to the beach with my family. We played in the sand and swam in the sea. We ate lunch together. I felt very happy.

questions.explanation_ar: اكتب ثلاث أو أربع جمل عن رحلة سابقة، واستخدم الماضي البسيط مثل went وplayed وate.
